evidence.snippet:
We see increasing integration of AI in hospitals: systems that auto-generate clinical notes from doctor‘s speech , “radiology agents” that pre-read scans , and even “digital doctor” projects for specific pathways .

I‘m keen to hear from medical professionals, hospital IT staff, or developers in this field about the ground truth.

What specific, repetitive tasks in your workflow have been successfully automated or augmented by AI? (E.g., documentation, coding, preliminary screening).

What has been the actual effect on your daily hours, mental load, and patient interaction time? Are the promised efficiency gains real?

What are the biggest frustrations? (e.g., AI “hallucinations” in notes, rigid workflows, integration nightmares with EHRs, or the time needed to review/correct AI output).

Please share your honest experience, good or bad.
